hero.subtitle: Trigger from Hand Gestures
hero.body: Control your media with acoustic sensing. No touch needed—just wave your hand through the air while enjoying the serene aquarium backdrop.

architect.title: Architect Dossier
architect.subtitle: Leon R. Darden // AI Solutions Architect
architect.content: Strategic and results-driven AI Solutions Architect with over 15 years of experience in systems support, technical operations, and client-facing solutions. Expertise lies in bridging the gap between raw machine logic and human-centric design. Recently completed the Google AI Professional suite, specializing in the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve enterprise challenges. My work focuses on high-fidelity RAG systems, autonomous agentic workflows, and secure AI infrastructure.
architect.metaBrand: The '?' represents the user's query; the '2' represents the transition to a solution. Every product in the ecosystem builds 'Brand Equity' for the next. WaVio is the sensory manifestation of this trust protocol.

gestures.title: Neural Mapping
gestures.subtitle: Acoustic Logic Gates
gestures.content: WaVio translates doppler shifts into binary commands. The Swipe (Rewind 15s), The Impact (Play/Pause), and the Air Wave (Skip) are the foundation of this touchless protocol. Each movement is decoded locally via the HTML5 Web Audio API.
